newsitem.title: USA: Exports to China, Japan objects of concern - Daley.
newsitem.headline: Exports to China, Japan objects of concern - Daley.

text.p: U.S. exports to China declined in February despite significant economic growth in China, Commerce Secretary William Daley said Thursday.
"China remains the only major market in the world where U.S. exports are not growing," Daley said. "This export picture remains an object of concern to me and to the administration."
Daley said the administration is also concerned about exports to Japan.

"We are hopeful that Japan will work diligently to create the conditions that will allow for balance and steady growth, which will be to the benefit of both trading partners," Daley said at a news conference.
